races.name: Book The Bistro In Seasons Restaurant Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Mel Rowley has her string in good nick so the returning JUST IN A BIT is fancied to capitalise on a handy-looking mark (form of his final start at Chepstow has been well advertised) and gain a first win. Moonlightinthepark is feared most on the back of a good recent Worcester second, although both Twist Of Fatecatch and Billy Boi Blue can also play a prominent role.

  1. JUST IN A BIT
  2. MOONLIGHTINTHEPARK (IRE)
  3. TWIST OF FATECATCH (FR)

races.name: Dance Through The Decades Christmas Parties Novices' Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
All of these arrive with a question to answer so it could pay to side with largely reliable hurdler KALKAROO to make a winning start in this sphere. Joyau Allen can also play a prominent role starting out over fences under the care of Jamie Snowden, while Walk The Plank is weighted to go well if back to his best.

  1. KALKAROO (IRE)
  2. JOYAU ALLEN (FR)
  3. WALK THE PLANK (IRE)

races.name: Southwell Racecourse Conference And Events Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Plenty of interesting contenders in this bumper, with CHINESE WHISPERS setting a good standard on his third at Warwick in March. He can make his experience count, although he comes up against a host of appealing newcomers. headed by Backwaters, Somniare and Music Maker.

  1. CHINESE WHISPERS (IRE)
  2. BACKWATERS (FR)
  3. SOMNIARE (IRE)

races.name: Winter Ladies Night Saturday 27th November 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This is likely to concern interesting hurdling debutants RICES POOL and Midnight Jukebox. Ben Pauling's charge is narrowly preferred with his Aintree bumper form working out well.

  1. RICES POOL (IRE)
  2. MIDNIGHT JUKEBOX (IRE)
  3. JETZET (IRE)

races.name: Festive Fixtures At Southwell Racecourse Mares' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
BLUE MARVEL can get off the mark and continue a good start to the season for Stuart Edmunds. Our Girl Sal and Dartmouth Rose appeal as the most likely dangers.

  1. BLUE MARVEL (IRE)
  2. OUR GIRL SAL (IRE)
  3. DARTMOUTH ROSE

races.name: Christmas Jumper Day Sunday 13th December Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
A tricky puzzle with INCA, Anxious Moments and Upton's Mighty Oak all looking potentially well treated. The former is taken to make it a hat-trick, following another strong-travelling display at Hereford last week.

  1. INCA (FR)
  2. ANXIOUS MOMENTS (IRE)
  3. UPTON'S MIGHTY OAK

races.name: Richard Soan Roofing Services Novices' Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
HARD STARE showed improved form in handicap hurdles on his last 2 starts and he boasts the physique to continue his progress as he goes over fences. Representing an in-form yard, he gets the vote ahead of Tom Taggle who is entitled to take a step forward from his recent return, while Could Be You is one to note as he goes chasing.

  1. HARD STARE
  2. TOM TAGGLE (IRE)
  3. COULD BE YOU (IRE)

races.name: Cappagh Browne Utilities Ltd Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Nicky Henderson's BOLD STEP has the benefit of a run over hurdles (chased home a progressive one), which may just give him the edge over interesting hurdling debutants Bailly's Comet and Le Cold Grey.

  1. BOLD STEP
  2. BAILLY'S COMET
  3. LE COLD GREY (FR)

races.name: Southern Contract Novices' Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
KNOWN WARRIOR didn't get very far on his comeback but shaped as if ahead of this mark on a couple of occasions last season and can get off the mark. Hiero Sport is going the right way over fences and his latest Market Rasen second looks good form, so is also shortlisted alongside Onewayortother.

  1. KNOWN WARRIOR (FR)
  2. HIERO SPORT (FR)
  3. ONEWAYORTOTHER (FR)

races.name: Southern Cranes Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
KOCKTAIL BLEU could be the one to beat following his encouraging fourth in a loaded renewal of the Silver Trophy on return. Sam Thomas typically looks to have his string in good early-season form, which may well bring Range into the mix, while Nardaran and Stream Of Stars also merit consideration in a competitive renewal.

  1. KOCKTAIL BLEU (FR)
  2. RANGE (IRE)
  3. NARDARAN (FR)

races.name: Kalm Club Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
JUBILANT represents the in-form James Owen team and with the benefit of a recent spin over hurdles under his belt he could well be the answer. Rickety Bridge is unbeaten over fences and can provide the biggest threat on his return.

  1. JUBILANT (FR)
  2. RICKETY BRIDGE (FR)
  3. ALIEN STORM (IRE)

races.name: Southern Access Platforms Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Lightly-raced hurdler SOUL LIMBO ought to be all the better for a recent pipe-opener on the Flat and looks a potential improver on handicap debut. He's narrowly preferred to One Island, who could be on a handy mark if back on song following a breathing operation. Goodwin Face can also go well, in what looks a trappy race.

  1. SOUL LIMBO (IRE)
  2. ONE ISLAND (FR)
  3. GOODWIN FACE (FR)

races.name: Final Fence Open 30th November Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
After a promising start to his career, THE BOSS BEAR's progress stalled in handicaps last season but he's since joined a yard which has a good record with new recruits. He could well revive and is the pick to get back to winning ways, though Coastal Command commands respect as he goes handicapping, with Calme Olympien also in the mix.

  1. THE BOSS BEAR (IRE)
  2. COASTAL COMMAND
  3. CALME OLYMPIEN (FR)

races.name: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap
races.verdict:
ANCIENT TIMES just gets the nod over Startling in a trappy sprint. Elvetham and Shalaa Asker should be thereabouts, too.

  1. ANCIENT TIMES
  2. STARTLING
  3. ELVETHAM (IRE)

races.name: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
The vote goes to GEMMARI, who may be able to dominate this small field. Fellow course winner Lady Ridgewood is feared most, ahead of unexposed 3-y-o Mother Dear.

  1. GEMMARI
  2. LADY RIDGEWOOD
  3. MOTHER DEAR

races.name: All-Weather Championship Is Back EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This can go the way of QUAI LOUIS who showed improved form on his third start when runner-up in a Brighton maiden last month. He is taken to go one better with his yard amongst the winners, at the chief expense of Reichenbach Falls who has shaped encouragingly in his 2 outings so far. Rocsane completes the shortlist.

  1. QUAI LOUIS (IRE)
  2. REICHENBACH FALLS
  3. ROCSANE (IRE)

races.name: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Nursery
races.verdict:
LAST DANDELION has taken her form up a notch switched to nurseries, getting off the mark at Bath before doing well to make the frame at Wolverhampton, so she is the pick to double her tally. Blue Pete looks to be on a workable mark for his nursery debut and is feared most, while Knock Three Times could go well back up in trip.

  1. LAST DANDELION
  2. BLUE PETE (IRE)
  3. KNOCK THREE TIMES (IRE)

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
WEDYAN sets the standard here and is fancied to defy a penalty. Lady's Grace is the obvious danger on paper, with Alpha Bella perhaps best of the rest.

  1. WEDYAN (IRE)
  2. LADY'S GRACE
  3. ALPHA BELLA

races.name: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
ARCHER'S GRACE made it 2 wins from her last 3 outings when scoring at Yarmouth, form boosted by the runner-up winning next time, and there could be better still to come as she makes only her third handicap start. She gets the vote ahead of Ice Sovereigns, who arrives on the back of success at Musselburgh, with Society Kiss also in the mix.

  1. ARCHER'S GRACE (IRE)
  2. ICE SOVEREIGNS (IRE)
  3. SOCIETY KISS

races.name: ARC All Weather Bonus Is Back Handicap
races.verdict:
INTERVENTION remains well treated and can follow up his recent Wolverhampton success. The in-form Dark Mandate is next on the shortlist ahead of Shades of May.

  1. INTERVENTION
  2. DARK MANDATE
  3. SHADES OF MAY

races.name: ARC All Weather Bonus Is Back Handicap
races.verdict:
MAGICIAN OF RIGA shaped well having been set plenty to do at Wolverhampton 4 weeks ago and he can resume winning ways. Metallo may pose the biggest threat back on all-weather, with Kokoluna taken to complete the 1-2-3.

  1. MAGICIAN OF RIGA (IRE)
  2. METALLO (IRE)
  3. KOKOLUNA

races.name: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap
races.verdict:
A dual C&D winner in September, THE ANTHONY GOVER has remained in top form, finding only one who had fallen plenty in the weights too strong over C&D 2 weeks ago. He looks a big player again under Billy Loughnane and shades preference over Crimson Road. Caledonian is another likely player if getting the breaks, whilst Under The Sun also needs bearing in mind on just his second start for James Owen.

  1. THE ANTHONY GOVER
  2. CRIMSON ROAD (IRE)
  3. CALEDONIAN

races.name: All Weather Championship Is Back Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
TWO COMMANDERS impressed when adding to his tally at Musselburgh 2 starts back and having raced closer to the pace than ideal when fifth at Chester subsequently, he's well worth another chance to prove his present mark a workable one. Chantelle has been shaping up well in handicaps and may emerge next best, ahead of another last-time-out winner, Montezin.

  1. TWO COMMANDERS
  2. CHANTELLE
  3. MONTEZIN

races.name: All Weather Championship Is Back Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
KING OF CHAOS has essentially been in better heart than recent form figures would suggest and, having fallen to just 1 lb above his last winning mark, Dylan Cunha's dual course winner could provide a spot of value returned to 7f. Sergeant Pep and Peter The Wolf are likely dangers, with Alaminos not one to write off just yet.

  1. KING OF CHAOS (IRE)
  2. SERGEANT PEP (IRE)
  3. PETER THE WOLF

races.name: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Nursery
races.verdict:
Not as competitive as the numbers suggest and CAVAN LADY is fancied to make light of a 2 lb rise for her breakthrough Redcar success and go 2-2 since joining Stephen Hanlon. The reliable Past Passion appeals as the one to give her most to do ahead of nursery debutant Fancied Angel.

  1. CAVAN LADY
  2. PAST PASSION
  3. FANCIED ANGEL

races.name: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
WOSTA made a promising start when a fast-finishing runner-up at Kempton and can go one better here. Steamroller could emerge as the main danger back from a break after an encouraging Newbury debut sixth, while Raider and Medaali also have more to offer and appeal as the pick of the rest.

  1. WOSTA
  2. STEAMROLLER (FR)
  3. RAIDER (IRE)

races.name: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Handicap
races.verdict:
THAT DARN CANTOR has started life well on a synthetic surface and can make light of a 4 lb rise for his breakthrough Kempton victory with this step up in distance looking a positive. The consistent Captain Cairney is feared most in his bid for a third win of 2026, ahead of Sea of Charm and Percy Jones.

  1. THAT DARN CANTOR
  2. CAPTAIN CAIRNEY
  3. SEA OF CHARM (FR)

races.name: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Handicap
races.verdict:
SHES GOT THE BLUES is enjoying an excellent season and can register a fifth victory racing off the same mark as when a good recent Newcastle third, with Billy Loughnane in the saddle again (won on her twice previously). Both Sovereign Bay and Labiche have their first runs for James Owen and could be the 2 to give the selection most to do.

  1. SHES GOT THE BLUES (IRE)
  2. SOVEREIGN BAY (FR)
  3. LABICHE

races.name: Midnite Built Different Handicap
races.verdict:
Lots with chances but STIPULATION rates just the pick of the weights and with Billy Loughnane back up he is taken to gain a first win of 2026. Deep Sleep is progressing gradually for James Owen and is next on the list, while Tiger Beetle and Snaafy also need factoring in.

  1. STIPULATION (IRE)
  2. DEEP SLEEP
  3. TIGER BEETLE

races.name: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap
races.verdict:
MACARONE is going from strength to strength and can defy a 3 lb rise to complete a 5-timer and again thwart A Lott of Kane, who rates a big threat in his bid for a fifth success of the year too. March of Time, Forever Glamorous and Geemann appeal as the pick of the rest in the battle for minor honours.

  1. MACARONE
  2. A LOTT OF KANE (IRE)
  3. MARCH OF TIME (IRE)
